name: frontend-developer-plugin
description: Build, fix, refactor, and review React frontend applications with version-aware guidance for components, hooks, data flows, accessibility, performance, and tests.

interface.shortDescription: Build React apps using the project's real stack and versions.
interface.longDescription: Implement and review React components, hooks, state, data and form flows, routing, styling, accessibility, performance, and tests while preserving the target project's framework, rendering mode, dependencies, and conventions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $frontend-developer to inspect this React project, implement the requested change using its installed stack and conventions, and verify the affected behavior.
